units.source_text: 千重子开始饲养金钟儿，约莫在四五年前，是在她发现老枫树上寄生的紫花地丁很久以后的事。

en.t: Chieko began keeping bell crickets about four or five years earlier, long after she had discovered the violets growing as parasites on the old maple tree.

units.source_text: 当时她在高中同学的起居室里，听见金钟儿鸣叫不停，便要了几只回家饲养。

en.t: At the time, she was in the living room of a high school classmate, and when she heard the bell crickets chirping without stop, she asked for a few and took them home to raise.
